notes.title: PRESETS
notes.text: PRESETS: a new bank, MNM, first in the list: 55 presets for MNM-1's machines. SWSAW (SUPERSAW HOOVER SAWBASS TRANCE WARMPAD), SWPLS (PWMLEAD SQRBASS THINPLS PWMPAD CHORUSPL), SID (SIDPULS SIDSYNC SIDRING SIDBASS CHIPTRI SIDNOISE FIFTHS), FM+ (FMKEYS EPIANO FMBASS TUBEBELL METALFM FMBRASS), DPRO (DPROWAVE ORGAN VOXSCAN FOLDBASS SYNCSWP SCANPAD), GND (GNDSINE GNDKICK GNDTOM GNDHAT ZAP DIGINOIS SUBSINE), VO-6 (VOX AH CHOIR WHISPER ROBOT OOH LOWVOX) and the FX machines (PLATE BIGROOM GATEDREV, CHORUS WIDECHO, FLANGER JETFLNG COMBRING, PHASER SLOWPHS, COMPRESS LIMITER, RINGMOD). A preset sets the machine and its 8 SYNTH knobs. Each machine's first preset is its default sound. The PRESETS knob steps through them; EDIT held opens the list.

notes.title: SID
notes.text: SID: RING on with the TRI wave played far out of range (a loud, broken sound); the ring now turns the triangle over within its range.
